# Contract — export and generated file formats

Examples are normative for structure, naming, ordering and header text; doc-comment wording may be refined during
implementation as long as it stays deterministic. Line endings below are shown as LF; `crlf` output differs only in line
endings. All files are UTF-8 without BOM.

## 1. Catalog export

`SampleHost --environment Local --export-wire-contract wire-contract.json` (excerpt; routes ordered by `name`):

```json
{
  "format": "gameserver.wire-contract/1",
  "frameworkVersion": "0.7.0",
  "protobufVersion": "3.36.2",
  "routes": [
    {
      "name": "battle.end",
      "methods": ["POST"],
      "template": "/api/v1/battle/end",
      "profile": "Player",
      "surface": "PlayerApi",
      "owner": "sample.game",
      "origin": "game",
      "operation": "battle.end"
    },
    {
      "name": "cheat.grant",
      "methods": ["POST"],
      "template": "/api/v1/cheat/grant",
      "profile": "Dev",
      "surface": "PlayerApi",
      "owner": "economy.cheat",
      "origin": "framework",
      "operation": "cheat.grant"
    },
    {
      "name": "gm.sso_start",
      "methods": ["GET"],
      "template": "/gm/v1/auth/sso/start",
      "profile": "Public",
      "surface": "GmApi",
      "owner": "gm",
      "origin": "framework",
      "condition": "gm.sso"
    },
    {
      "name": "platform.health_live",
      "template": "/health/live",
      "profile": "Public",
      "surface": "Host",
      "owner": "platform.observability",
      "origin": "framework"
    },
    {
      "name": "platform.receipt",
      "methods": ["GET"],
      "template": "/api/v1/player/receipts/{receiptId}",
      "profile": "Player",
      "surface": "PlayerApi",
      "owner": "platform",
      "origin": "framework"
    }
  ],
  "sections": [
    {
      "id": "battle",
      "owner": "sample.game",
      "origin": "game",
      "message": "samplegame.v1.BattleState"
    },
    {
      "id": "wallet",
      "owner": "economy",
      "origin": "framework",
      "message": "gameserver.economy.v1.WalletState"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Generator config

`samples/SampleGame/wiregen.json`:

```json
{
  "format": "gameserver.wiregen/1",
  "catalog": { "hostProject": "../SampleHost/SampleHost.csproj", "environment": "Local" },
  "origin": "game",
  "protos": [
    { "root": "SampleGame.Adapters/Protos", "files": ["sample_game.proto"] },
    { "root": "../../modules/Sample.Counter/Sample.Counter.Adapters/Protos", "files": ["sample_counter.proto"] }
  ],
  "output": {
    "root": "KestrelDemo",
    "marker": "Assets/SampleGame",
    "directory": "Assets/SampleGame/Generated",
    "layout": "flat",
    "lineEndings": "lf"
  },
  "namespace": "SampleGame.Client",
  "routesClass": "SampleGameRoutes",
  "sectionsClass": "SampleGameSections"
}
```

Outputs: `Assets/SampleGame/Generated/SampleGame.cs` (unchanged path), `SampleCounter.cs` (new),
`SampleGameRoutes.cs` (new), `SampleGameSections.cs` (new).

## 3. Routes file

Header (both generated file kinds):

```csharp
// <auto-generated>
//   Generated by GameServer.WireGen (framework 0.7.0) from the server's route catalog. Do not edit:
//   change the route declaration on the server and run the generation step again.
// </auto-generated>
#nullable enable
```

`Runtime/Generated/FrameworkRoutes.cs` (excerpt; members ordered ordinally by route name, each route's `…Method` right
after it):

```csharp
namespace GameServer.Client
{
    /// <summary>Player-facing routes of the framework, relative to the SDK base URL (no leading slash).</summary>
    public static class FrameworkRoutes
    {
        /// <summary><c>POST api/v1/cheat/grant</c>: command <c>cheat.grant</c>, profile Dev (Development/Test servers only), module <c>economy.cheat</c>.</summary>
        public const string CheatGrant = "api/v1/cheat/grant";

        /// <summary>HTTP method of <see cref="CheatGrant"/>.</summary>
        public const string CheatGrantMethod = "POST";

        /// <summary><c>POST api/v1/identity/login/guest</c>: profile Public, module <c>identity</c>.</summary>
        public const string IdentityLoginGuest = "api/v1/identity/login/guest";

        /// <summary>HTTP method of <see cref="IdentityLoginGuest"/>.</summary>
        public const string IdentityLoginGuestMethod = "POST";

        /// <summary><c>* health/live</c>: profile Public, module <c>platform.observability</c>; any HTTP method.</summary>
        public const string PlatformHealthLive = "health/live";

        /// <summary>HTTP method of <see cref="PlatformHealthLive"/> (<c>*</c> = any).</summary>
        public const string PlatformHealthLiveMethod = "*";

        /// <summary><c>GET api/v1/player/receipts/{receiptId}</c>: profile Player, platform.</summary>
        public static string PlatformReceipt(string receiptId) =>
            "api/v1/player/receipts/" + global::System.Uri.EscapeDataString(receiptId);

        /// <summary>HTTP method of <see cref="PlatformReceipt"/>.</summary>
        public const string PlatformReceiptMethod = "GET";

        /// <summary><c>GET v1/time</c>: profile Public, platform.</summary>
        public const string PlatformTime = "v1/time";

        /// <summary>HTTP method of <see cref="PlatformTime"/>.</summary>
        public const string PlatformTimeMethod = "GET";
    }
}
```

Rules: a parameter helper takes the parameters in template order, named as in the template (C# keywords prefixed with
`@`), each value escaped with `Uri.EscapeDataString`; a segment like `{id}.json` becomes `escape(id) + ".json"`.

## 4. Sections file

`Runtime/Generated/FrameworkSections.cs`:

```csharp
namespace GameServer.Client
{
    /// <summary>Client-visible sections of the framework: id constants, typed keys and the id → parser table.</summary>
    public static class FrameworkSections
    {
        /// <summary>Section <c>inventory</c> (module <c>economy</c>), message <c>gameserver.economy.v1.InventoryState</c>.</summary>
        public static readonly global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.InventoryState> Inventory =
            new global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.InventoryState>(InventoryId, global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.InventoryState.Parser);

        public const string InventoryId = "inventory";

        /// <summary>Section <c>profile</c> (module <c>identity</c>), message <c>gameserver.identity.v1.ProfileState</c>.</summary>
        public static readonly global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Identity.Protocol.V1.ProfileState> Profile =
            new global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Identity.Protocol.V1.ProfileState>(ProfileId, global::GameServer.Modules.Identity.Protocol.V1.ProfileState.Parser);

        public const string ProfileId = "profile";

        /// <summary>Section <c>wallet</c> (module <c>economy</c>), message <c>gameserver.economy.v1.WalletState</c>.</summary>
        public static readonly global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.WalletState> Wallet =
            new global::GameServer.Client.SectionKey<global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.WalletState>(WalletId, global::GameServer.Modules.Economy.Protocol.V1.WalletState.Parser);

        public const string WalletId = "wallet";

        /// <summary>Every typed section above (register a game's own table with SectionStore.Register).</summary>
        public static readonly global::GameServer.Client.SectionTable Table = new global::GameServer.Client.SectionTable(Inventory, Profile, Wallet);
    }
}
```

`const` members are compile-time values, so the static field initializers that reference them are order-independent;
`Table` is emitted last. An untyped section emits only `public const string XId = "x";` with the comment
`(registered without its message type: no parser)`.

## 5. Client usage

```csharp
// Unity game code
client.Sections.Register(GameSections.Table);                          // once, after creating the client
var progress = client.Sections.Get(GameSections.Progress);              // ProgressState or null
var wallet = client.Sections.Get(FrameworkSections.Wallet);
var init = await client.SendCommandAsync(GameRoutes.AccountInit, new InitAccountRequest(), InitAccountResult.Parser);

client.Sections.SectionChanged += id =>
{
    switch (client.Sections.TryRead(id, out var message))
    {
        case SectionRead.Parsed when message is ProgressState p: /* … */ break;
        case SectionRead.Unknown: /* newer server: section kept raw, update the client */ break;
    }
};
```
